safe.question: Is this extension safe?
safe.answer: Yes. Everything runs locally in your browser — nothing about your browsing is ever sent to a server. The extension requests only the permissions it needs to do its job.

data.question: Do you collect my data?
data.answer: No. No browsing history, no page content, no analytics, no telemetry. We have no servers storing your activity because we never receive it.

sites.question: Does it work on all websites?
sites.answer: Yes. It works on almost every site in your browser. If you run into any issues, feel free to reach out. You decide which keywords or patterns trigger each action.

license.question: How does the lifetime license work?
license.answer: Pay once, get a license code, and use it forever on any device you own. All future updates are included for free.

custom.question: Can I customize the keywords and shortcuts?
custom.answer: Absolutely. Add or remove keywords and change shortcuts to match your workflow — all from the extension's settings page.
